name: net.nuvits/mcp
title: Nuvits VPS
description: Compare Linux and Windows VPS plans in BRL with Pix, inspect servers and orders, and control power.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the Nuvits VPS plans for sale, with resources, region, operating systems, available periods and prices in cents of BRL. Billing cycle 30_days is the monthly plan: each period ends on the same day of the next month (28 to 31 days). annual covers 12 months. cycle_days is kept for compatibility; do not present it as the period length.
